# Realism / proportionality reference (anchors, not hard limits)

Drives the loader's "this looks low/high for an org your size" warnings. Anchors below are for
a healthcare provider; payer equivalents in parentheses. Override with a justification (kept as provenance).

| Org size (annual revenue) | System C-suite | + per-entity execs | VPs (approx) | IT budget (% rev) | Security FTE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ~$300M (community, 1 hospital) | 6–9 | n/a | 8–15 | 3–5% (~$9–15M) | 3–8 |
| ~$1B (regional, 2–3 hospitals) | 9–12 | CEO/CMO/CNO each | 20–35 | 3–5% (~$30–50M) | 8–20 |
| ~$2B (IDN, 3–5 hospitals) | 10–15 | CEO/CMO/CNO each | 30–60 | 3–5% (~$60–100M) | 15–40 |
| ~$5B+ (large system) | 14–20 | + regional presidents | 60–120 | 3–5% (~$150–250M) | 40–100 |
| ~$11B (Meridian: 23 hospitals, 6,800 beds, 42k FTE) | 14-20 | + regional presidents | 60-120 | ~3.0% (~$340M) | ~60 |

Other anchors:
- **Applications (CMDB):** Epic-core IDN → hundreds–low-thousands of apps/CIs.
- **Vendor contracts:** dozens–hundreds; top-5 vendors often 40–60% of IT spend.
- **KPIs per role:** CEO ~15–20 · CFO ~30 · COO ~30 · CMO ~20 · CNO ~15 · CIO/CDAO ~15.
- **Payer:** C-suite ~10–12; MLR 85–88%; admin ratio 10–12%; members drive ops scale.
